resources.string: The camera opens first when you launch the app. If Android asks for permission, allow it. After capture you can straighten the page; letter recognition is still in development. The photo stays on your phone.
Choose a photo or take one. The app finds brightness boundaries and displays an image with contours. This is not letter recognition.
Take a photo or choose an existing image.

Could not read the image. Choose PNG/JPEG/WebP.
Could not open the camera or capture an image. You can choose an existing photo.
Allow camera access to open the camera. You can also choose an existing photo.
Drag the four green corners to the page boundaries. If automatic detection is wrong, adjust the frame manually.
Corners could not be detected confidently. Adjust the frame manually.
Could not straighten the image. Check the corner order and frame size.
